jobs.title: SAFe Product Manager
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
The SAFe Product Manager leads the definition, prioritization, and execution of product and platform investments across one or more Agile Release Trains (ARTs). You will be the primary connection between business strategy, customer needs, and engineering execution, translating market opportunities and stakeholder requirements into actionable development roadmaps and features. You will collaborate with commercial, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and program leadership teams to guide investment decisions and ensure delivery of customer and business value.

You will report to the SAFe Team Lead and will work a hybrid schedule based in Mequon, Wisconsin.

Your Responsibilities:
- Develop and own the feature backlog and roadmap for product development projects according to our priorities
- Manage the alignment between Product Requirement Documents (PRD) and Agile Release Train feature backlog for development projects
- Work with multiple stakeholders inside the business and development teams to set a direction for implementation and balance priorities
- Work with multiple stakeholders outside the business segment to coordinate implementation plans with aligned products
- Work with development teams to break down implementation barriers and coordinate resolution of issues with necessary stakeholders
- Guide the development team in achieving predictable, high-quality objectives by responding to issues and making quick decisions
- Develop intuitive familiarity with product, technology, R&D, and market factors to collaborate across technical and commercial teams
- Manage several simultaneous projects related to the efficiency of the Agile release train.
- Assist the Commercial Business Management and Product Management as assigned in responsibilities required to meet global business unit and department goals.
- Assist the Business in implementing and achieving the global business unit Product strategy and Annual Operating Plan.
- Partner with and coordinates through Product Management to resolve complex internal/external customer problems with broad and long-term possible effects; and respond with urgency to needs and deliver cost-effective quality solutions.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
- Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field
- Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening
- Willing to travel up to 10%

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:
- Typically requires 2 years of related experience.
- In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies and techniques
- Knowledge of, or experience with Rockwell Automation drives and software products
- Demonstrated working within a matrix environment to achieve multiple simultaneous goals
- You will communicate complex sets of information in simple ways to multiple levels of stakeholders
- Understanding of business profit and loss responsibility

What We Offer:
- Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
- 401k
- Paid Time off
- Parental and Caregiver Leave
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and company-sponsored access to Calm app
- Health management program
- Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
- To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www. raquickfind.com .

Position Summary:
Plex, by Rockwell Automation, is the leading cloud‑based, multi‑tenant Manufacturing Execution System (MES), Quality Management System (QMS), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform for manufacturers, recognized as an MES market leader by multiple industry analysts.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager for our Enterprise Platform team to own and evolve the core platform capabilities that determine how Plex connects, secures, models, and moves data across the manufacturing ecosystem.

Reporting to the Group Product Manager for Platform, Data & AI , you will define the strategy and roadmap for Plex's data and integration capabilities. You will work closely with engineering, domain product teams, customers, and GTM teams to shape how Plex data is exposed and consumed by humans, systems, and agents.

This is a senior product leadership role designed for a PM ready to grow into broader platform leadership responsibility. You will operate at the intersection of technical depth, customer engagement, and stakeholder influence.

We are looking for someone who has earned their technical fluency, not just studied it. You have built integrations, designed APIs, implemented enterprise systems, or led API modernization initiatives at some point in your career. - Lead product vision, roadmap, and execution for Plex's Data & Integration platform, including APIs, events, IAM, integrations, and core data services; establish clear metrics for business impact.
- Own product strategy for enterprise customers, including prebuilt integrations, cross-cloud support, and platform capabilities large manufacturers need at scale.
- Lead API and integration strategy, including migration to modern REST, event-driven, and MCP-compatible interfaces.
- Drive platform capabilities that reduce implementation time and lower TCO, including sandbox tenant tooling, pre-built connectors, and implementation agents.
- Serve as primary product voice with enterprise customers and GTM teams, leading discovery, advisory conversations, executive alignment, and enablement.
- Collaborate with domain product teams (MES, QMS, ERP) to ensure data, events, and integration definitions support their roadmaps and reduce platform fragmentation.

Job Description
The AI Product Owner serves as the primary business liaison between GSM (Global Sales and Marketing) functions and the GSM AI delivery team. You will identify business challenges and lead discovery. You will gather and clarify requirements, prioritize AI opportunities, and partner with experts. These experts include AI Developers, Enablement Specialists, Process Architects, and Project Managers. Together, you will deliver solutions that improve productivity, efficiency, and user experience.

You will translate needs into actionable work, own use cases through discovery and delivery, maintain priorities, coordinate stakeholder decisions, and confirm that solutions achieve intended outcomes. The AI Product Owner is not accountable for enterprise AI strategy or portfolio governance. Instead, you will drive execution of the GSM AI roadmap through business partnership, disciplined product ownership, and use-case leadership.

Your Responsibilities:

Discovery & Problem Definition

- Partner with GSM stakeholders to identify business challenges, users, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
- Define current and future-state processes, scope, constraints, dependencies, and important partners.
- Focus on the underlying business need rather than a predetermined solution.

Requirements & Backlog Management

- Gather, validate, and document requirements, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
- Manage and maintain the backlog, including enhancements, defects, priorities, dependencies, and decisions.
- Ensure work is clearly defined and development ready before execution.

Prioritization & Governance

- Assess requests based on business value, user impact, complexity, risk, readiness, and capacity.
- Recommend priorities, tradeoffs, and sequencing to GSM AI leadership.
- Escalate unresolved ownership, policy, funding, data, or capacity issues when needed.

Solution Delivery

- Partner with Process Architects and AI Developers to translate business needs into effective solutions.
- Support backlog refinement, design reviews, testing, demonstrations, and acceptance activities.
- Manage scope changes and ensure partners understand impacts and dependencies.

Pilot & Adoption

- Define pilot objectives, success criteria, participants, and feedback mechanisms.
- Collect and translate user feedback into prioritized improvements and adoption actions.
- Partner with enablement and business leaders to support communications, training, and change management.

Value Realization

- Establish success measures and expected outcomes upfront.
- Monitor adoption, usability, efficiency, and business impact metrics.
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, reuse, and broader AI adoption.

Stakeholder Communication

- Provide transparent updates on scope, priorities, decisions, risks, and outcomes.
- Maintain alignment between business needs, delivered capabilities, user feedback, and measured results.
- Ensure work is paused or closed when ownership, readiness, value, or priority is insufficient.

jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description
The role of the Product Owner, Software is to maximize value of the product being delivered by the Scrum Team.

You will report to the Software and DevSecOps Engineering Manager and will work a hybrid schedule based in Mequon, Wisconsin.

Your Responsibilities:
- Manage one or more Team backlogs that are thoughtful, visible, and the "single source of truth". Work flowed to your Team will typically originate from multiple products.

- Define backlog items, including clear and concise acceptance criteria.

- Define and communicate an inspiring vision of what the backlog items will provide when integrated together.

- Prioritize backlog items and optimize their flow to multiple Teams, especially in preparation of both recurring PI Planning events and proposed system-level products 'due dates'.

- Track the Sprint-by-Sprint goals and PI-by-PI objectives, in support of quality and on-time Releases, typically at Sprint or PI boundaries.

- Ensure the Teams understand the required intent of backlog items.

- Enable Team Members to effectively showcase the most critical components of the developed product to relevant Stakeholders.

- Enable Team Members to practice lean development by reducing waste and planning infrastructure and maintenance stories.

- Work effectively with the Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer, Product Manager, Scrum Team Members, and all applicable Stakeholders relating to tools, process, techniques, and relationships.

- Comprehend blocking items that prevent planned work from being completed, then navigate contingency planning of secondary priorities and execution.

The Essentials - You Will Have:
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience

- Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

- Ability to travel up to 10%

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:
- Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience

- Significant experience with Rockwell Drives and other Rockwell products.

- Significant experience in the industrial automation industry.

- Experience in Software development.

- Familiarity with C#, Angular, .NET MAUI, C++, WPF, MFC, and Xamarin.

- Experience in SAFe, with POPM certification.

- A mentoring and advisory role in Scrum, with PSPO certification.

What We Offer:
- Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision

- 401k

- Paid Time off

- Parental and Caregiver Leave

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and company-sponsored access to Calm app

- Health management program

- Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.

Job Description

You will strengthen revenue impact by managing the product marketing work that directly improves win rates and launch success. You will lead and scale our win/loss program, systematically capturing why we're deals and why we're not. Then, they will package those insights into clear, relevant guidelines for sales, product, demand generation, and leadership. You will guide competitor analysis and battle cards to sharpen difference in active deals. You will work with external partners to align joint positioning and co-marketing motions. You will manage end-to-end product launches with the right narratives, enablement, and assets.
You will report to the Manager, Sr. Strategic Portfolio Marketing

These elements span the customer journey and product lifecycle, comprising emails, in-app notifications, release updates, FAQs, web and community content, product and roadmap webinars/videos.
- Market Research involves collecting and compiling intelligence from multiple sources. These sources include market, competitive, industry analyst, customer (VoC), and win/loss data. This compiled intelligence informs corporate and product strategy, and target market and ideal customer profile definition.
- Enablement enables teams across the organization, including sales. It achieves this by communicating the target market, personas, value proposition. Additionally, it involves building enablement and education tools. These tools support a sales motion and organizational "everboarding". You include presentations, videos, talk tracks, battle cards, demos, and internal FAQs.
- Global Expansion - Orchestration of localization related activities and assets including management of translations and regional enablement
- Product Content Development involves preparing and updating product marketing materials. These materials include solution and industry-based content, as well as analyst briefing content, partner and integration materials, marchitecture diagrams, and technical documentation. Technical documentation encompasses RFP sections, architecture and security documents, and more.
